name: New Student — Status Changes to Pending Demo After Email 2
description: Giulia enters the New Student journey as a new lead. After Email 2 is sent (while in Check 1), her status changes to 'Pending Demo' — she booked a demo lesson. The journey should exit early at Check 1 (Status ≠ New).

step_events.description: Salesforce updates Status to Pending Demo (lead booked a demo lesson between Email 2 and Check 1)

name: New Student — Status Changes to Follow Up Call After Email 4
description: Marco stays New through Check 1 and Check 2, receives Email 4. Before Check 3, his status changes to 'Follow Up Call' — a call was scheduled. Journey should exit early at Check 3.

step_events.description: Salesforce updates Status to Follow Up Call (call was scheduled while lead was in the wait period)

name: New Student — Stays New All the Way Through (Full Journey)
description: Giulia never progresses — stays Status=New through all 3 decision checks. Should receive all 5 emails and exit normally at the end.

name: Pending Reminder — Demo Date Rescheduled After Reminder Sent
description: Sofia receives the day-before demo reminder email. Before the journey exits, her demo date is pushed to next week. The current journey run completes (exits). She will re-enter the Pending Reminder journey the new day before her rescheduled demo (re_entry=true).

step_events.description: Demo date was rescheduled in Salesforce — Demo_Date updated while contact is in the final wait

name: Show Demo — Contact Converts (Status_in_LG Changes) After Email 2
description: Elena attended the demo and is being nurtured. After Email 2 is sent, the sales team converts her in Salesforce — Status_in_LG changes away from 'Done Demo'. Check 2 should fire the NO branch and exit the journey early.

step_events.description: Contact was enrolled — Status_in_LG updated in Salesforce (no longer 'Done Demo')

name: Show Demo — Contact Never Converts (Full 4-Email Nurture)
description: Luca attended the demo but does not convert. Status_in_LG stays 'Done Demo' through all 3 checks. He receives all 4 emails and exits at the end of the journey.

name: New Franchisee — Status Changes to NDA Signed After Email 1
description: Roberto enters as a new franchisee lead. After Email 1, his status is updated to 'NDA Signed' in Salesforce. Check 1 should fire the NO branch — Status ≠ New — and exit early. He will then enter the NDA Signed journey.

step_events.description: Franchisee signed the NDA during the wait period after Email 1

name: NDA Signed Franchisee — Status Changes to PPT Booked Mid-Nurture
description: Francesca is in the NDA Signed journey. After Email 1, she books a PPT presentation — Status changes to 'PPT Booked' in Salesforce. The journey should detect Status ≠ NDA Signed at Check 1 and exit early. She will then enter the PPT Booked journey.

step_events.description: Franchisee booked a PPT presentation — Status updated to PPT Booked in Salesforce

name: North NDA Signed — Franchisee Never Progresses (Full 3-Email Run)
description: Ivan is in the North NDA Signed journey. His status stays 'NDA Signed' through all 3 decision checks. He receives all 3 emails and exits normally.

name: North NDA Signed — Status Changes to Follow Up Call at Check 2
description: Ivan receives Email 1 and Email 2. Between Check 2, his status changes to 'Follow Up Call'. The journey exits early at Check 2. Demonstrates that the North journey (3 checks) catches mid-journey progression later than the South version.

step_events.description: Franchisee status updated to Follow Up Call in Salesforce

name: [Debug] New Student — Force All YES Branches (Stays New)
description: Use _force_split to pin all 3 decision checks to YES — simulates a contact who never changes status, even if the field data is ambiguous. Useful for testing the complete email sequence.

name: [Debug] New Student — Force Exit at Check 1
description: Pin Check 1 to NO — simulates a contact who progresses right after Email 2 regardless of field values. Useful for testing the early-exit path.
